review.verdict: Cast and labels keep both mind-reading stories legible and kind, but the planned split-panel background never materializes (both halves render the same navy), and several components (glass, headband, signal lines, note) float disconnected from the figures they're meant to act on — a passable but shaky piece.
revisionNotes: Make the split-frame divide actually visible — give the right half a distinct paper/cream background or add a vertical divider line; right now both halves render as the same navy, so the two-story parallel (company reading him vs. device reading them) isn't legible as a split.

Move the 'glass' magnifying circle down so it overlaps or clearly aims at the 'exec' figure (currently it floats in the top floor with no visual link to the person below it, scale ~1.1 and nudge to x 0.24, y 0.4).

Close the gap between 'headband' and the 'wired' head, and start 'signals' right at the headband arc instead of as a separate floating cluster higher up — the brain-reading chain currently looks like three disconnected pieces stacked vertically.
Fix 'note': set holds so the torn heart note reads as held in the exec's hand rather than a flag floating beside the arm.
Bottom third of the frame (below y~0.75) is empty blue on both sides — bring the ground swoosh up or shift figures down slightly to use the square better.
Blue blueprint palette, cloud icon, and building cross-section repeat heavily in recent pieces — vary accent color or panel treatment next time.
